title: DAP advertises supportsSetVariable=true but does not implement the setVariable request
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: Godot 4.6.3.stable.official [7d41c59c4].
- Current `master` source at `5ec4857b340b6284a18b49b2eda462bd250f219a` still advertises the capability, while the parser does not bind a `req_setVariable` handler.

### System information

Microsoft Windows 11 Pro, build 26200 - Godot 4.6.3.stable.official [7d41c59c4]

### Issue description

Godot's Debug Adapter Protocol initialization response advertises:

```json
"supportsSetVariable": true
```

However, Godot does not implement the corresponding DAP `setVariable` request.

On current `master`, `editor/debugger/debug_adapter/debug_adapter_types.h` initializes `supportsSetVariable = true` and serializes it into the capabilities response:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/5ec4857b340b6284a18b49b2eda462bd250f219a/editor/debugger/debug_adapter/debug_adapter_types.h

The request dispatcher maps incoming commands to parser methods named `req_<command>`, but `DebugAdapterParser::_bind_methods()` has no `req_setVariable` binding/implementation:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/5ec4857b340b6284a18b49b2eda462bd250f219a/editor/debugger/debug_adapter/debug_adapter_parser.cpp
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/5ec4857b340b6284a18b49b2eda462bd250f219a/editor/debugger/debug_adapter/debug_adapter_protocol.cpp

This is misleading to DAP clients. According to the protocol, clients may expose variable editing when `supportsSetVariable` is true, but the advertised operation cannot be completed by Godot.

Expected behavior: either implement the DAP `setVariable` request, or advertise `supportsSetVariable = false` until it is implemented.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Start a Godot project with the Debug Adapter Protocol enabled.
2. Connect any DAP client to Godot and send `initialize`.
3. Observe that the response contains `"supportsSetVariable": true`.
4. While stopped at a breakpoint, have the client issue a standard DAP `setVariable` request for a visible variable.
5. Godot has no `req_setVariable` handler for that advertised request, so the operation is not supported despite the capability being `true`.

The source-level mismatch is also visible without a particular client: `supportsSetVariable` is present in `DAP::Capabilities`, while `DebugAdapterParser::_bind_methods()` contains no `req_setVariable` method.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A. The capability/request mismatch is in the engine's DAP implementation and is reproducible with any small GDScript project that can stop at a breakpoint.
